name: Wysa
one_liner: AI chatbot app with CBT and DBT-based exercises for stress, anxiety and low mood; free to use, with paid premium tools and text coaching.
best_for: People with everyday stress, worry or low mood who want a free self-help chat at any hour
People who want to practise CBT and DBT skills between therapy sessions
People whose employer or health plan provides Wysa premium
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need diagnosis, therapy or medication for moderate to severe symptoms
short_description: AI chatbot app for stress, anxiety and low mood. The chat is free; premium exercises and text-based coaching cost extra.
long_description: Wysa is an AI chatbot app from Wysa Ltd (originally Touchkin) that offers structured conversations and self-help exercises based on CBT, DBT and mindfulness for stress, anxiety, low mood and sleep. It is designed for people aged 13 and over and says it is not suitable for crisis situations. Anyone in the US can still download it from the App Store and Google Play and use the AI chat for free; premium content and text-based coaching with human coaches are sold as in-app purchases, with US App Store items reported between $4.99 and $144.99 as of October 2026. Wysa also sells to employers, health systems and the NHS, and people who get it through an organisation receive premium at no cost. Wysa says it does not sell data or share it with advertisers, and uses some anonymised messages to train its AI. It has a randomized trial in people with arthritis or diabetes and several uncontrolled studies. It is a self-help tool, not therapy.
patient_summary: You download Wysa on your phone and chat with an AI 'penguin' that suggests short CBT, DBT and mindfulness exercises when you feel stressed, anxious or low. The basic chat is free; you can pay in the app for premium exercises or text sessions with a human coach. If your employer or health plan offers Wysa, premium is included.

pricing.notes: AI chat is free. Premium and coaching are in-app purchases; US App Store items listed from $4.99 to $144.99 (Oct 2026), including Premium (Annual) at $74.99 and $99.99. Wysa does not publish a consumer price list on its site. Free premium if provided by an employer or health plan.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell or share data with advertisers; in-app 'reset my data' deletes it; anonymised messages may train its AI; HIPAA status for consumer app not stated.

seo.title: Wysa: AI Therapy + Human Coaching | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Wysa is an AI mental health chatbot offering CBT-based support, with optional human coaching for anxiety, depression, and stress management.

faqs.a: Wysa's AI chatbot is free to use with substantial content. Premium features and human coaching sessions cost extra—typically around $99/month for unlimited coaching. Some employers and health plans provide Wysa premium as a benefit.

faqs.q: Does Wysa offer real human support?
faqs.a: Yes, Wysa offers text-based coaching with trained mental health professionals as a premium add-on. You chat with the AI for immediate support and can book coaching sessions for more personalized human guidance. Coaches are not licensed therapists but trained in supportive techniques.

Multiple studies show Wysa's AI significantly reduces symptoms of depression and anxiety. Research published in JMIR demonstrated clinical improvements after 2 weeks of use. It's evidence-based but should complement, not replace, professional care for moderate to severe conditions.

faqs.q: How is Wysa different from Woebot?
faqs.a: Both are AI mental health chatbots. Wysa offers optional human coaching for additional support. Woebot is entirely free but AI-only. Both use CBT techniques. Try both to see which conversation style resonates—they have different personalities.

clinical_trials.study: RCT of Wysa vs no intervention for 4 weeks in adults with arthritis or diabetes

citation.authors: MacNeill AL, Doucet S, Luke A
citation.title: Effectiveness of a Mental Health Chatbot for People With Chronic Diseases: Randomized Controlled Trial

clinical_trials.outcome: Depression and anxiety scores fell in the Wysa group but not the control group; stress did not change.

clinical_trials.study: Real-world evaluation of Wysa users with depressive symptoms

citation.authors: Inkster B, Sarda S, Subramanian V
citation.title: An Empathy-Driven, Conversational Artificial Intelligence Agent (Wysa) for Digital Mental Well-Being: Real-World Data Evaluation Mixed-Methods Study

clinical_trials.outcome: More engaged users had larger improvements in depression scores; no control group.

primary_uses: Self-help chat for stress and worry
Text coaching with a human coach (paid)

how_clinicians_use_it: Recommend for between-session support with AI and optional coaching
Provide patients access to CBT, DBT, and mindfulness exercises
Supplement treatment for patients who need more frequent check-ins
Use as step-down support as patients transition out of intensive treatment
clinician.implementation_notes: HIPAA-compliant version available for enterprise. Consumer version can be recommended directly. Enterprise version offers organization dashboards.

availability.note: Consumer app still downloadable and usable free in the US (App Store and Google Play, Oct 2026). Wysa also sells to employers and health systems; removed from the UK MHRA device register in Sept 2026.
